import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createHttpServer } from "../../generated-scaffold/ts/modules/bootstrap.ts";
import { createRoleBasedAuthority } from "../../generated-scaffold/ts/interfaces/api/dto.ts";
import { cashFundPurchaseHandler } from "../../handwritten/cash-fund-purchase.cloze.ts";
import { taBridgeSettlementHandler } from "../../handwritten/ta-bridge-settlement.cloze.ts";

async function withServer<T>(externOverrides: Record<string, Record<string, () => boolean>>, fn: (baseUrl: string) => Promise<T>, authority?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const handlers = {
    "CashFundPurchase": cashFundPurchaseHandler,
    "TaBridgeSettlement": taBridgeSettlementHandler,
  };
  const { server } = createHttpServer({ handlers, externOverrides: externOverrides as never, authority: authority as never });
  await new Promise<void>(resolve => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve()));
  const addr = server.address();
  const port = typeof addr === "object" && addr ? addr.port : 0;
  try {
    return await fn(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise<void>(resolve => server.close(() => resolve()));
  }
}

async function withBareRouter<T>(fn: (baseUrl: string) => Promise<T>, authority?: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const { server } = createHttpServer({ handlers: {}, authority: authority as never });
  await new Promise<void>(resolve => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve()));
  const addr = server.address();
  const port = typeof addr === "object" && addr ? addr.port : 0;
  try {
    return await fn(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise<void>(resolve => server.close(() => resolve()));
  }
}

// @CoArisingSpec(id="INTERFACES_HEALTH", witness="http-health")
test("[INTERFACES_HEALTH] GET /health -> 200 ok", async () => {
  await withServer({}, async baseUrl => {
    const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/health`);
    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
    const json = await res.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
    assert.equal(json.status, "ok");
    assert.equal(json.system, "bank-wealth");
    assert.equal(json.context, "bankwealth");
  });
});
